stories.raw_headline: IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws
stories.description: arXiv:2610.40518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts.
